# Sameer Khan - Software Engineer

> Sameer Khan is a Software Engineer with a B.S. in Computer Science from Sonoma State University (graduated with honors, May 2025). He specializes in full-stack development using React, Next.js, TypeScript, and Node.js, with additional expertise in AI/ML, computer vision, and cloud technologies (AWS). Based in the San Francisco Bay Area.

## About Sameer Khan

Sameer Khan is a new graduate Software Engineer passionate about building innovative web and mobile applications. With a strong foundation in computer science fundamentals and hands-on experience in modern web technologies, he brings expertise in:

- **Full-Stack Development**: Building end-to-end applications using React, Next.js, TypeScript, Node.js
- **AI/ML & Computer Vision**: Research experience in land cover classification using machine learning
- **Cloud Technologies**: AWS certified with experience in Docker containerization
- **Programming Languages**: Proficient in JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, Java, and C++

Sameer graduated with honors from Sonoma State University, where his coursework included Database Management System Design, Data Structures & Algorithms, Computer Architecture, Software Design & Development, Intro to OOP, Computer Networking, and Analysis of Algorithms.

## Projects

### BioSoundSCape (Spring 2025)
**Role**: Computer Vision Researcher
- Research project focused on land cover classification using machine learning
- Applied computer vision techniques for environmental analysis
- Technologies: Python, Machine Learning, Computer Vision
- Repository: https://github.com/sameerkhansf/BioSoundSCape_SSU_Computer_Science

### DFA/NFA Builder (Fall 2024)
**Role**: Automata Theory Project
- Built a tool for creating and visualizing deterministic and non-deterministic finite automata
- Implements core concepts from automata theory and formal languages
- Technologies: Java
- Repository: https://github.com/sameerkhansf/JFLAPAutomataBuilder

### C++ Interpreter (Spring 2025)
**Role**: Compiler Project Developer
- Implemented an interpreter demonstrating programming language theory concepts
- Covers lexical analysis, parsing, and execution
- Technologies: C++
- Repository: https://github.com/sameerkhansf/Interpreter

### Expense Tracker Application (December 2024)
**Role**: Full Stack Developer
- Full-stack web application for personal expense tracking
- Features data visualization and expense categorization
- Technologies: React, Node.js, MongoDB
- Live Demo: https://expense-tracker-mocha-three.vercel.app
